name: Contributor Actions
on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
    types: [opened, synchronize, reopened]
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  setup:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    outputs:
      changed-files: ${{ steps.changed-files.outputs.all_changed_files }}
      is-main-branch: ${{ github.ref == 'refs/heads/main' }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Get changed files
        id: changed-files
        uses: tj-actions/changed-files@v42
        with:
          separator: ","

  lint:
    needs: setup
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: "20"
          cache: "npm"

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      - name: Run ESLint
        run: npm run lint

  test:
    needs: setup
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: "20"
          cache: "npm"

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      - name: Run tests
        run: npm test

  build:
    needs: setup
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: "20"
          cache: "npm"

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      - name: Build project
        run: npm run build

  notify-slack-success:
    needs: [lint, test, build]
    if: success() && github.event_name != 'pull_request'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Notify Slack Success
        uses: tenstorrent/tt-metal/.github/actions/slack-report@main
        with:
          owner: "mastra-ai"
          slack_webhook_url: ${{ secrets.SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL }}

  notify-slack-failure:
    needs: [lint, test, build]
    if: failure() && github.event_name != 'pull_request'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Notify Slack Failure
        uses: tenstorrent/tt-metal/.github/actions/slack-report@main
        with:
          owner: "mastra-ai"
          slack_webhook_url: ${{ secrets.SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL }}

  cache-dependencies:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: "20"

      - name: Cache dependencies
        id: cache-npm
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: ~/.npm
          key: npm-${{ hashFiles('package-lock.json') }}
          restore-keys: |
            npm-

      - name: Install dependencies
        if: steps.cache-npm.outputs.cache-hit != 'true'
        run: npm ci

  trigger-deployment:
    needs: [setup, cache-dependencies, lint, test, build]
    if: needs.setup.outputs.is-main-branch == 'true' && needs.setup.outputs.changed-files != ''
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Trigger deployment workflow
        uses: benc-uk/workflow-dispatch@v1
        with:
          workflow: deploy.yml
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          ref: main
